title: Fusion Utility Depends on the Evaluator: Code, protocols, source data, and revision package
description:
Archival release accompanying Fusion Utility Depends on the Evaluator: A Boundary Study of Confidence-Shielded Input Selection for Infrared-Visible Object Detection.

Version v3.0.1 contains the final code, fixed split and test manifests, hashed prospective protocols, per-image detector score arrays, source-data tables, and the complete v40 submission package. It adds the development-constrained candidate-library analysis, a 900-frame temporal LLVIP confirmation of the visible-plus-PIAFusion policy, leave-one-sequence-out sensitivity, six-checkpoint end-to-end latency measurements, M3FD seed replication, CDF parameter sensitivity, standard confidence-ordered matching analyses, independent DroneVehicle and VEDAI evaluations, and the joint fusion-detection baseline.

The LLVIP, M3FD, DroneVehicle, and VEDAI images, third-party detector weights, fusion-model weights, and generated fused-image corpora are not redistributed. Their public sources, fixed manifests, per-file hashes, and reproduction instructions are documented in the repository and submission archive.
